decision: Selected the centroid of the union of the six Grant County tax parcels owned by Grant Node Property LLC and Backbone Mining Solutions LLC in the Carlile Development MP Lot 1 industrial binding site plan, at the south-west corner of Tyndall Rd NE and Randolph Rd NE near Moses Lake, as the campus locator for Keel's Moses Lake data campus.

facts.corner_check: Grant County Road Centerlines put the Tyndall Rd NE / Randolph Rd NE intersection at (-119.29217, 47.19709); the union lies 11 m from it, in the quadrant south of Tyndall Rd NE (which runs west-north-west from the intersection) and west of Randolph Rd NE: Tyndall Rd NE runs along the north edge, where the parcel boundary overlaps the county centerline by at most about 3.4 m over 196 m (a 575 m2 sliver, a digitising offset), Randolph Rd NE lies 9.7 m from the east edge and Carlile Ln 12 m from the south-west side; the centroid is 134 m from the intersection. facts.acreage_bridge: The City of Moses Lake hearing-examiner agenda of 28 January 2026 places the proposed Bitfarms data center on 6 acres at the south-west corner of Tyndall Road NE and Randolph Road NE; the union is 5.97 geodesic acres; Keel's campus page gives 6 acres
